purpose: Teach: 優越/数理/復刊/論説/前項/想起/体現/個所

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、他大学への優越意識を捨てろ
lines.en: Ren — drop the superiority complex about other universities.
lines.style: Clear, paternal firmness. Light emphasis on the instruction itself. Measured pace, no anger. The tone of someone who sees the flaw and names it because it matters for his growth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究では数理的な厳密さを大事にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll prioritize mathematical rigor in my research.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Absorbing the feedback without over-apologizing. Quick acknowledgment followed by concrete commitment. Eager to show he understands.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、絶版論文集の復刊を学会に提案しろ
lines.en: Ren — propose to the academic society that they reissue that out-of-print collection.
lines.style: Deliberate task-setting. Slight pause after the name. Calm instruction, not a suggestion. The voice of someone delegating work he believes his mentee can do.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論説形式での発信も検討します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also look into presenting it in essay form.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Following orders with initiative — not just compliance but thinking a step ahead. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の前項を読み返せ
lines.en: Ren — read back through the paper's introduction again.
lines.style: Specific correction, delivered without reproach. Calm confidence. The instruction of a mentor who knows what the student needs to see.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先行研究を想起しやすい引用を心がけます
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure my citations are clear enough to help with recalling prior research.
lines.style: Earnest self-correction. Showing he's already thinking about how to improve. Quick, focused. The slight edge of someone pushing himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究倫理を体現する姿勢を貫け
lines.en: Ren — stay committed to embodying research ethics in everything you do.
lines.style: Shift to principle, not just process. Quieter, more weight in the words. The final word carries more gravity. A reminder wrapped as direction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の不明個所を指導教授に確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll check with my advisor about any unclear points in the paper.
lines.style: Closing affirmation with concrete action. Quiet, steady resolve. The voice settling into commitment. Slight softness on the final phrase — relief at having a clear next step.
